chapters: SignalLab · Replay one traffic trace through three SLO alert policies.
1 / Request-weighted burn uses actual request counts and complete rolling windows.
2 / Switch services to inspect their five-minute and one-hour burn.
3 / Compare episodes, false episodes, firing time and detection delay together.
4 / Change the SLO and replay the same seed. Every chart and table is recomputed.
5 / Multiwindow rules trade shorter firing time for later detection in this synthetic trace.
Independent local evaluator · Import your own counts · No production paging or universal-winner claims.
scope: Uncut automated capture of the local Python app with an isolated temporary database.
